# `csharp_place_simple_declaration_blocks_on_single_line`

Collapse a method, constructor, operator, destructor, local function or accessor body onto one line when it holds a single statement with no comment and the result fits.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_place_simple_declaration_blocks_on_single_line = true`

```ini
csharp_place_simple_declaration_blocks_on_single_line = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double() { return Value * 2; }
}
```
:::

::::
